_comment: Committed in-tree roster of the MCP tool names this repo's doctrine relies on.
Why this file exists: the #995 gate used to read $PI_AGENT_DIR/mcp.json (or
~/.pi/agent/mcp.json) as a roster source, so a CI box with no user Pi config
and a laptop with one disagreed about which names were real. A gate whose
verdict depends on whose machine ran it is not a gate. Everything the doctrine
names must be declared HERE, with the server it comes from and a reason.
The gate reads nothing under HOME (asserted by test-tool-name-surface.ts).
Adding a name: it must be a real tool the named server publishes, and the
reason must say which doctrine file names it. In-tree .pi/mcp.json is still
read as a second, also-host-independent source when a clone keeps one.

tools.name: search_code
tools.reason: Named by its bare shorthand in agents-base/developer.md and modules/core/codebase-memory-mcp.md, which documents the short-name convention explicitly.

tools.name: search_graph
tools.reason: Named as a granted codebase-memory tool in the agents-base/developer.md tool-surface table (#1434 grounding).

tools.name: trace_path
tools.reason: Named by its bare shorthand in agents-base/developer.md and modules/core/codebase-memory-mcp.md for callers/callees.

tools.reason: Named by its bare shorthand in agents-base/developer.md and modules/core/codebase-memory-mcp.md for diff blast radius.

tools.reason: Named in agents-base/developer.md to tell developers what coverage report to consult; granted to no role, so the permission-map leg cannot see it.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.reason: Named in agents-base/developer.md to tell developers how to discover indexed projects; granted to no role.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.reason: Named in agents-base/developer.md precisely to FORBID the call — a gate that called an accurate prohibition a phantom would punish accurate doctrine.

tools.name: compare_graphs
tools.reason: Named in agents-base/developer.md to say the call is not granted; listed so the gate does not call a real-but-ungranted tool a phantom.

tools.name: manage_adr
tools.reason: Named in agents-base/developer.md as the ADR seam; granted to no role, named so the prompt can describe it.
